0x100635B0.name: CMoSpline_BuildSegmentTables
0x100635B0.evidence: Called by CMoSpline_EnsureSamples on its +4 object. For the three arrays at this+0xC..0x14 extends the end points (wrapped when this+0x24); per segment the length of the coordinate deltas through g_pProcessor's method at +0x94 (at least 0.01; 1 when this+0x25), summed into this+8; a 4x4 matrix per segment from neighbouring lengths into this+0x1C; the lengths divided by the total.
0x100635B0.summary: Builds the spline's per-segment lengths (normalized by the total) and per-segment 4x4 basis matrices.
